name: Damian
site: o2.de · Mobile and home internet, Germany
headline: Turn Telefónica’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells unlimited tariffs, home internet from 19,99 € a month and phones on contract to every visitor the same way, including the ones who already have a tariff with you.

Once a customer is logged in, how much data they use, when they roam and when prepaid customers run low is your strongest signal for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today it sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Upgrade, cross-sell and anti churn campaigns for tariffs, family lines and roaming are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from data volume, roaming use, prepaid top-ups and contract end dates. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right tariff when it fits
cases.text: Next best tariff, add-on or family line per customer, triggered by data use and roaming. No more blanket upgrade mails to customers who already have the right tariff.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep every customer using their plan
cases.text: Personal data, roaming and home internet nudges in My account, email and on the homepage, orchestrated so every customer has a reason to use their plan this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
